name: Osteoblast / osteoclast
failures: Osteoporotic imbalance, non-union fracture, osteogenesis imperfecta.

see.note: DEXA measures density, not cell activity; turnover markers are indirect.

model.note: Bone remodelling balance is well understood.

reach.note: Bisphosphonates and denosumab reach and modulate these cells effectively.

edit.note: Pharmacological modulation, not cell repair or replacement.

verify.note: DEXA and fracture incidence are solid endpoints.

anchors: Bone is one of few tissues that truly self-repairs
